g.text: Evidence may leave several backgrounds, not a single noise value
Illustrative SCM: X=U_X, Y=X+U_Y. Independent noises have P(1)=0.25.
Evidence Y=1 retains (1,0) and (0,1), each with posterior weight 0.5.
After X:=0, keep these posterior weights instead of resampling the prior.
